Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_Elfsong_Githyanki_InquisitorInterrogation.json: You're in a githyanki hideout of the Knights of the Shield when Ch'r'ai Har'rak and his watch (W'wargaz) spot you and Lae'zel and immediately identify you as carrying an important artifact — the Astral Prism. Ch'r'ai speaks for Vlaakith's faction, threatens to seize the Prism and present the "false heir's head" as a trophy, and derides Lae'zel as an unascended who would steal his glory. The player replies defiantly, insisting they protect the Prism (framing it as either the queen's charge or the key to freedom), which pushes the scene toward violence or arrest. Off‑screen flags matter here: prior late‑game choices (who holds crucial artifacts like the Prism or Netherstones, whether Orpheus lives or is transformed, and which companions — Lae'zel, Voss, Karlach — are present) will shape whether this encounter becomes a fight, a standoff, or a bargaining moment.
